- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:407-414 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Docstring continuation lines in `open_or_update_discovery_pr` use mixed tabs and spaces for indentation.
  WHY: Ruff E101 rejects the mixed whitespace, and CI already reports this as a merge-blocking lint failure.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:417-424 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Docstring continuation lines in `_dispatch_discovery` use mixed tabs and spaces for indentation.
  WHY: Ruff E101 rejects the mixed whitespace, and CI already reports this as a merge-blocking lint failure.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:457-464 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `dry_run` path returns before `_append_discovery_memory` runs, so the memory-write path is never exercised.
  WHY: Dry-run operators are told the memory plumbing is validated end-to-end, but a broken append path would not be caught until a non-dry run.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:474-483 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `discover_manifest_via_codex` is called with `sleep_fn=lambda _seconds: None`, which disables the documented retry backoff.
  WHY: Retries run back-to-back with no delay, so transient Codex failures burn attempts and API budget faster than intended.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:548-580 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The label-fallback retry strips `--label` whenever stderr/output contains the substring `"label"`, even for unrelated failures.
  WHY: A transient non-label failure that happens to mention “label” can create the PR without the intended label and mask the real cause.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:847-860 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_dedup_skip` collapses memory-helper failures into the same path as a normal miss instead of distinguishing read errors from “no prior record”.
  WHY: When the memory helper errors, the dedup decision becomes incorrect rather than reflecting the read failure as a distinct condition.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:490 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `git add` always includes `entry_script_relative_path` even when the entry script was never written.
  WHY: On disagreement paths this can produce a pathspec error for a nonexistent file, and the current `check=False` call silently absorbs it.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:254-261 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The outer exception handler can leave the working tree on the discovery PR branch if the failure happens after checkout but before return.
  WHY: In that case the drift pipeline may render against the wrong tree state and report a false drift.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:489-510 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The module-level regex constants are defined but not used because the slugify helpers recompile the same patterns inline.
  WHY: This is dead code that does not change behavior, but it misleads readers and increases maintenance risk if the copies diverge.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:424-448 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: There is a TOCTOU race between listing existing open PRs and creating a new one.
  WHY: Two concurrent runs can both miss the existing PR and then race to create the same branch, producing one noisy duplicate-create failure.
- tests/test_validation_refresh_runner.py:510-520 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test patches `time.sleep` globally and relies on `finally` to restore it.
  WHY: If an assertion fails before the restore executes, later tests inherit the patched sleep and timing-sensitive behavior can be distorted.
- agents.md:211-218 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new `VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_*` log-prefix constants are not yet mapped in the orchestrator’s label-reconciliation logic.
  WHY: Discovery-created PRs may be misclassified as unknown phases and trigger incorrect stall-recovery or warning behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:474 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The call to `discover_manifest_via_codex` passes `sleep_fn=lambda _seconds: None`, which disables the exponential backoff between retry attempts.
  WHY: Retries execute back-to-back with zero delay, wasting API credits and increasing the chance that transient failures exhaust all attempts.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:457-463 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `dry_run` path returns before `_append_discovery_memory` is called, so the memory-write path is never exercised.
  WHY: Operators running dry-run validation will not discover a broken memory append path until the first non-dry-run invocation.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:490 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git add` always includes `entry_script_relative_path` as a pathspec argument, regardless of whether the entry script file was actually created.
  WHY: On the disagreement path this can emit a `pathspec did not match any files` error for a nonexistent file, which is currently swallowed by `check=False`.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:548-552 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label-fallback condition checks whether `"label"` appears anywhere in stderr/output before retrying without `--label`.
  WHY: A non-label-related failure that happens to mention “label” can silently drop the label on retry and create the PR without the intended label.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:254-261 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `_dispatch_discovery` raises an unhandled exception, the post-discovery checkout guard may skip the tree reset if `result.discovery_outcome` stays `None`.
  WHY: If the exception happens after a branch checkout, the working tree can remain on the discovery PR branch and later steps may run against the wrong state.
